key.answer_key: The Al 2p fit in the panel resolves two components: Al2O3 at about 75.4 eV and a metallic Al peak at about 78.2 eV, positioned above the oxide peak and roughly 4x larger in intensity than it (o20). The strong, dominant metallic-Al signal alongside a much smaller oxide component indicates most of the underlying aluminium is still exposed rather than fully covered, consistent with the claim that the Ce layer is very thin and non-uniform and that the nanoparticles are only partly covered by Ce oxides/hydroxides.
